content: Oh, I see—no board‑games class. Is learning video‑game design the same as learning to play board games?

No, learning video‑game design focuses on coding, mechanics, graphics and software tools—very different from the social, tactile experience of playing board games. The catalogue has no board‑games offering, and a design class wouldn’t teach you how to play them.
